features.title: Dispatch agent/request-messages on stock DSH
features.summary: Wrap the llm runtime's innermost adapter call so every agent-loop request runs the agent/request-messages waterfall and sends the messages its listeners return, with config, tools and tool history unchanged.
failureModes: A DSH llm runtime without adapterStream reports active=false through request-messages/status and dispatches nothing.
A listener that throws is logged and the derived messages are sent, unless the request was cancelled.

verification.reason: Host-only bundle with no UI; its effect is exercised by the unit tests and the OptMem runtime A/B in plugins/@dshfiles/optmem/docs/runtime-evidence.md.

verification.testName: sends the messages a listener returns for an agent-loop request
leaves requests the agent loop did not build untouched
restores the runtime when the last copy unloads
dispatches once when two copies are loaded
